lessons.title: Greetings & Introductions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-001"
cando: "Can greet people, introduce oneself, and ask basic questions in spoken English."
lessons.recycled: Initial course anchor: establishes baseline target-language sounds, primary greetings, and fundamental sentence patterns.

lessons.title: Asking Simple Questions & Clarification
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-002"
cando: "Can ask simple questions and request clarification when speaking."
lessons.recycled: Grammar: Verb 'to be' (present simple), Possessive adjectives (my, your) · Vocabulary: Good morning, Nice to meet you, My name is, Welcome (reused and expanded in Asking Simple Questions & Clarification)

lessons.title: Basic Shopping & Ordering Phrases
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-003"
cando: "Can order food, drinks, and buy basic goods in shop transactions."
lessons.recycled: Grammar: Possessive adjectives (my, your), Question words (What, Where, How), Can for requests · Vocabulary: Pardon?, Could you repeat that?, Slowly, Understand (reused and expanded in Basic Shopping & Ordering Phrases)

lessons.title: Asking for & Giving Directions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-004"
cando: "Can ask for and give basic street directions."
lessons.recycled: Grammar: Can for requests, I would like..., How much is...? · Vocabulary: Price, Buy, Order, Receipt (reused and expanded in Asking for & Giving Directions)
